Tablet.dc.html.title: Tablet · 820 × 1180 (768–1023: scaled desktop canvas, touch swipe)

Mobile.dc.html.title: Mobile · 390 × 844 (≤767: mobile canvas, swipe + bottom sheets)

n1.text:
Breakpoints
• Mobile ≤767: mobile canvas, page fits width, horizontal swipe between layouts, bottom-sheet editing (Edit / Layout / Theme / Zoom).
• Tablet 768–1023: desktop canvas scaled via transform stage, touch swipe (native scroll-snap), floating bottom panel for layouts + themes. No wheel hijack.
• Desktop ≥1024: fit-to-height stage, vertical wheel/trackpad = one layout per gesture, floating inspector dock.
• Folded 466×678 → mobile rules. Unfolded 890×626 → tablet rules. DPR 3x: everything is vector/text, no raster.

All frames share one resume store (localStorage), so edits in one frame appear in the others.
